notes.summary: Continuous PC on a common-H book is exactly page convexity plus one common ambient support at every real H point; the full-affine rational-spatial above approximation is reconstructed.
notes.detailedSummary: The proof uses inherited feasible midpoint density, perspective feasible density for real PCC, strict quadratic maximum, full convex Lipschitz derivatives, and separation of compact product subdifferentials from the closed entire restriction image. Full-affine majorants have global error, prescribed rational contacts, actual recession and genuine rational projected faces despite real heights. No independence or automatic raw-PC continuity is used.
notes.text:
Translate a rational H point to zero and set E=sum L_i. For a rational polyhedron at a feasible real point, impose every active inequality as an equality. Gaussian elimination gives a rational particular solution and rational kernel basis. Rational approximation of its coordinates remains feasible because all inactive inequalities have positive slack. This proves rational density in the minimal face, without a carrier coarsening. For a legal PCC discard zero weights and use variables (alpha_i,t_i=alpha_i x_i). Cell inequalities A_i x_i≥b_i become A_i t_i≥alpha_i b_i, with sum alpha_i=1 and sum t_i in the center face. They are rational linear constraints. Rational feasible approximants eventually have positive weights and rational endpoints t_i/alpha_i; continuity passes their printed inequalities to the real legal PCC.

At any page point x, its minimal inherited face tau has a neighborhood avoiding all finitely many nonincident closed cells. Nearby x±u lie in incident page cells. The rational feasible system z in tau, z±v in those cells, z,v in L_i yields legal rational midpoint triples tending to (x,u). Thus a continuous PC function is locally midpoint convex. On an arbitrary segment subtract its chord to obtain q with endpoint values zero. If q is positive internally, q+epsilon t², with epsilon small, has an interior maximum. The local midpoint inequality makes its symmetric endpoint average exceed the maximum by epsilon s², a contradiction. Therefore each entire-page restriction is convex.

A finite convex function on a whole vector space is locally Lipschitz: its values on a cube are bounded above by its finitely many vertex values; reflection through the center bounds them below on a smaller cube; extending secants a fixed distance inside that cube bounds both difference quotients. Its directional derivative h_i is finite, continuous and sublinear by secant monotonicity, the Lipschitz bound, rescaling and the convex inequality at 2t v and 2t w. Nearest-point separation of a point below a closed epigraph supplies affine supports; at a full-domain boundary graph point the limiting inward unit normal has positive vertical component, since zero vertical component would force its entire spatial component to vanish. Applied to sublinear h_i, tests at 0 and 2w force support intercept zero. Hence K_i=partial f_i(y) is nonempty compact convex and h_i(w)=max_{K_i}ell(w).

Let K=product K_i and S=image(E*→product L_i*). S is a closed linear subspace regardless of tangent overlap. If K misses S, minimizing the squared norm of its perpendicular projection gives a≠0 with <a,z>≥||a||² for all z in K. Represent −a by page vectors w_i. Orthogonality to S means sum w_i=0 in E, while sum h_i(w_i)=max_K sum ell_i(w_i)≤−||a||². For small t, the endpoints y+t w_i have barycenter y and negative total function increment. Their cells are incident to y's minimal face; the perspective argument above gives a legal real PCC and contradicts PC. Thus K meets S and one ambient p supports all pages at every real y in H. Conversely page Jensen applies to a center outside H because all its incident cells lie in its unique page. At a center y in H, summing the common ambient support inequalities cancels p(sum alpha_i(x_i−y)) and proves every PCC. Shared trace alone does not suffice.

For the full-affine construction, write an actual convex reference gamma=max_j(a_j(x)+b_j), h=max_j a_j(x), Delta=conv{a_j}. The carrier recession cones cover all directions: an unbounded ray has a subsequence in one of finitely many cells. On each cone h is that cell's slope. Positive recession implies pointed cells and 0 in the interior of Delta. Their finite rational spatial ray generators lift with the actual real heights h(r), giving exactly epi h as their cone plus the upward ray. For |f−gamma| bounded, f*=phi has domain exactly Delta: p(x)≤h(x) bounds it there, and strict spatial separation makes it infinite outside. It is convex LSC and finite on the whole polytope, including the boundary. Such a function is continuous on the whole polytope: at x all active inequalities permit a ray toward any nearby feasible z; a radius chosen below every inactive slack is uniform, so convexity bounds phi(z) above by phi(x) plus O(||z−x||) times the largest vertex value. LSC gives the other inequality. This also proves uniform continuity by compactness.

Choose finitely many rational samples covering the entire compact Delta so g_A(p)=max_a(p(a)−f(a)) lies between phi−eta and phi; append any prescribed finite rational contacts. Define E_A=conv{(a,f(a))}+epi h. A finite conic representation can be reduced to independent generators by eliminating coefficient dependencies, so finite cones are closed. The first summand is compact: an affine-dependency elimination reduces every convex combination to at most dimension+1 points, making the hull a continuous compact image. Thus E_A is closed. Its projection is all the page, and convexity plus f(x+v)≤f(x)+h(v) puts it above epi f. Its finite lower function F_A has conjugate g_A on Delta and infinity outside. Full-domain support/biconjugacy then gives f≤F_A≤f+eta globally and exact appended contacts. The same bound gives exact actual recession.

Each lower graph face is generated by a subset of the rational spatial samples and rational ray positions, with real heights. Its projection is a rational hull/cone. Projection is affine and injective on each graph face; intersections project to common faces. All such faces form a genuine finite rational carrier. Rational matching equations on shared faces have a rational kernel basis; denominator clearing makes each basis function literal integral-slope PA with rational constants, so the real coefficient vector is in the genuine real scalar extension. No slope rounding or irrational maximum-wall claim occurs. This proves the whole old289 affine foundation using ordinary real completeness, compactness, linear algebra, convex secants and the explicit elementary separation above. Artifacts: Sections 2–4 of P05.1-paper.tex and argument.md.

notes.summary: The joint compact dual has simultaneous minima in every trace fiber, including boundary fibers; lowering these minima preserves one common ambient support.
notes.detailedSummary: With D={p:r_i p in Delta_i}, phi=max phi_i, the common-support criterion proves G=phi*≤f_i and G|H=f_H. Compact fiber minimization and closed-convex biconjugacy give k=f_H* and T(D)=Delta_H. Each separate page fiber minimum equals k; hence every joint minimizer minimizes ALL pages. Compact hull trace lowering produces global f_i≤F_i≤f_i+eta, exact whole trace g and shared supports, without assigning MA to intermediate F_i.
notes.text:
Use the full-affine and common-support results of n2. Let phi_i=f_i* be finite continuous on the whole actual compact Delta_i, possibly irrational. With restriction maps r_i:E*→L_i* and T:E*→H*, set D={p:r_i p in Delta_i for all i}, phi=max_i phi_i(r_i p). D is a closed finite real polyhedron. If unbounded, normalize an unbounded sequence; compactness gives a unit limit annihilating every L_i because every restriction stays bounded. Since E=sum L_i the limit is zero, a contradiction. Thus D is compact. A common supporting p_y belongs to D and has all phi_i(r_i p_y)=p_y(y)−f_H(y); D is nonempty and phi is finite continuous convex.

G=phi* obeys G(x)≤f_i(x) for x on page i, since phi≥phi_i∘r_i. The one common support at y in H has Fenchel equality on every page, so G(y)=f_H(y). No equality away from H is claimed. Define k(q)=min_{p in D,Tp=q}phi(p) on T(D). Fibers are compact and attain minima; mixing minimizers proves convexity. For a convergent q_n choose minimizers along a lower-limit subsequence; their compact convergent subsequence proves LSC. The compact polytope boundary-continuity argument in n2 makes k continuous on its entire domain. Grouping suprema by fibers gives k*=G|H=f_H.

For completeness, extend k by infinity outside T(D). A point (q,t) below epi k with q in its domain has a strict nearest-point separator (A,beta), beta≥0. Testing the epigraph point (q,k(q)) in the same spatial fiber gives beta(k(q)−t)>0, hence STRICTLY beta>0. Dividing produces an affine minorant of k taking value above t at q. Taking t upward proves k**=k at all domain points, including the boundary. Outside the compact domain, a spatial separator u with u(q)>max_domain u makes (s u)(q)−k*(s u) tend to infinity. Therefore k=f_H* as an extended closed convex function and its entire domain T(D) is Delta_H.

For each single page repeat compact fiber attainment, mixing, LSC and this biconjugacy for U_i:L_i*→H*. Its fiber minimum k_i has conjugate f_i|H=f_H and therefore equals k, with exactly the same whole domain. Consequently every p in D has phi_i(r_i p)≥k(Tp) for every page. If p jointly minimizes max_i phi_i at Tp=q, the maximum is k(q); each individual value is also at most k(q), so ALL are exactly k(q). The compact set M={p:phi(p)=k(Tp)} surjects onto every q in Delta_H. This is simultaneous equality from one ambient p, not a choice of unrelated separate minimizers.

For any finite convex trace g with f_H≤g≤f_H+eta and exact trace recession, b=g* is continuous on all Delta_H and k−eta≤b≤k. Set S_i={(r_i p,b(Tp)):p in M}, and E_i=conv(graph phi_i union S_i)+vertical-up. Its source set is compact; affine-dependence elimination reduces every convex combination to at most the ambient dimension+1 terms, proving compactness of the hull, and compact-plus-closed-ray is closed. Its finite attained lower boundary psi_i is closed convex on all Delta_i. Every source lies above phi_i−eta, the graph is included, and all sources lie above b∘U_i. Convexity gives phi_i−eta≤psi_i≤phi_i and psi_i≥b∘U_i. For ONE p in M over each q, every added source has height b(q), so psi_i(r_i p)=b(q) for ALL i. Thus all entire page fiber minima equal b.

F_i=psi_i* is finite continuous convex with f_i≤F_i≤f_i+eta globally, exact actual page recession, and F_i|H=b*=g. At any real y in H, compactness/continuity attains g(y)=q(y)−b(q). Choose ONE joint p in M over that q. For every page and every x, F_i(x)≥p(x)−b(q)=g(y)+p(x−y). The same ambient p supports every F_i at y. By n2 their continuous gluing is PC. They need not be PA and receive no MA. This chain works for arbitrary dependent page directions and continuous nonseparable trace data; it uses one common H for all restrictions. Artifacts: Sections 5–6 of P05.1-paper.tex and argument.md.

notes.summary: Entire rational-PA trace extension gives global decreasing approximants with the same actual real reference; every unrestricted C_b envelope enters the domain before MA.
notes.detailedSummary: Appending all finite trace vertices and exact trace recession forces equality on the whole H, while being above intermediate F_i preserves every shared support. Rational hyperplane refinements and scalar matching give genuine finite PA PC. Errors≤2eta followed by common 4eta shifts give [4,6]eta and next≤3eta. The dependent H=0 case is separate. R230 supplies actual envelope continuity; the approximation precedes S272.
notes.text:
Use n2–n3. First approximate f_H from above by a finite rational-spatial REAL PA convex g with exact trace recession and f_H≤g≤f_H+eta. The full-affine primal proof in n2 applies on H with its inherited actual reference. Positive recession makes carrying cells pointed. Each rational cell is the hull of its finitely many rational vertices plus its rational recession cone: homogenization and finite active-rank elimination prove this finite generation. Since g is affine on the cell, the ENTIRE epi(g) equals the hull of all lifted rational vertices (with actual real heights) plus epi(h_H). The reverse inclusion uses convexity and the exact recession inequality. Dimension zero has a single lift and the vertical ray.

Take intermediate F_i from n3 and apply n2's primal above construction with error eta, appending ALL the trace vertices on every page. Its epigraph contains all those lifts and the exact branch epi(h_i), hence contains epi(g) over H. Thus Q_i|H≤g. Since Q_i≥F_i and F_i|H=g, it is exactly g on the whole H. The global error is f_i≤Q_i≤f_i+2eta. Every common ambient support of F_i survives: it stays below Q_i and still touches at every y in H. Thus n2 gives PC of the gluing. The projected graph-face proof produces actual rational spatial carriers even with irrational heights, and rational matching gives genuine real scalar extension.

Cut all carriers by rational ambient hyperplanes whose intersection is H. Refine their induced rational trace complexes and the trace carrier by their common finite rational hyperplanes; extend these equations rationally to E, as well as all page-wall equations. Cutting all pages by the finite resulting arrangement gives a genuine common rational complex. Distinct pages meet only in H, so their intersections are common faces there. Values and supports are unchanged. No irrational slope wall is imposed and no carrier is coarsened.

For eta_n=2^(−n), n≥1, obtain Q_n with 0≤Q_n−f≤2eta_n globally. Set P_n=Q_n+4eta_n with the SAME constant on every page. Then 4eta_n≤P_n−f≤6eta_n and P_(n+1)−f≤3eta_n<4eta_n≤P_n−f at every point globally. Hence these are genuinely decreasing and uniformly convergent, with unchanged actual page recession and common relative norm≤||f−gamma||+3. For H=0 take g=f(0) exactly and append the origin in each separate page primal construction; every original common support survives, giving the simpler error≤eta_n. Dependent bouquets therefore require no normal independence.

The actual sum of positive complete-page cycles is balanced: primitive quotient normals on each page's two sides cancel in its saturated lattice, separately also at facets in H. R230, retained in n1, applies to every u in C_b(X) and gives the ACTUAL unrestricted endpoint P_gamma(u), continuous printed PC and |P_gamma(u)−gamma|≤||u||. The above construction then places this endpoint in the genuine real completion before any completed operator. R230 itself was not treated as PA regularization.

Upper-only and bounded two-sided competitor sets have the same envelope. If q≤gamma+u and C=||u||, max(q,gamma−C) is PC: use the active center function's PCC inequality and increase its endpoints to the maximum. It is below the obstacle, dominates q, and lies between gamma−C and gamma+C. This is a competitor argument, not finite rational PA max closure. Arbitrary printed-PC downward irrational spikes need not be continuous, so none receives a new operator automatically. This proves the scoped universal real common-H theorem conditionally on the retained envelope grant, not the complete original classifications. Artifacts: Section 7 of P05.1-paper.tex, argument.md and proof-source-coverage.md.

notes.summary: Whole diagnostic293 is verified exactly: identical entire trace and individually convex primal pages have legal PCC cost −3/64; naive gluing fails while the original Huber endpoint is regularizable.
notes.detailedSummary: The rational saturated three-page book has normal relation v1+v2+v3=0, actual reference |t|+|s| and Huber endpoint. Its three common sample lifts generate the supporting plane t/2−3s/8 and the entire trace −t, t/2, t−1/2. Endpoint barycentrics (1/4,1/4,1/2) give 13/64 versus center 16/64. The failed glued approximant receives no MA.
notes.text:
In R³ take H the t-axis and page normals v1=(0,1,0), v2=(0,0,1), v3=(0,−1,−1), with common tangent (1,0,0). Every pair intersects exactly in H and sum v_i=0. Each page lattice is saturated: for the third plane x=y every integral point is an integral combination of its displayed two vectors; the coordinate pages are immediate. All weights are one. In primitive coordinates (t,s) use gamma_i=|t|+|s| and f_i=Huber(t)+Huber(s), where Huber(z)=z²/2 for |z|≤1 and |z|−1/2 outside. Its continuous nondecreasing derivative proves convexity, and −1≤f_i−gamma_i≤0. At (t0,0,0) the common ambient form Huber'(t0) dt supports every page, because Huber(s)≥0. The reference has the analogous common t support and positive recession. By n2 the original f and reference are PC.

Use on each page exactly the samples (0,0),(1,0),(1/2,1/4) with heights 0,1/2,5/32. The hull of these lifts plus epi(|t|+|s|) gives a finite above-primal convex rational-spatial PA F_i with exact recession. The plane L(t,s)=t/2−3s/8 has all three heights, and its gradient lies in [−1,1]², so it supports the entire generated epigraph and agrees with F_i throughout the sample triangle.

The entire trace is exactly −t for t≤0, t/2 on [0,1], and t−1/2 for t≥1. Indeed any third-sample coefficient a contributes s=a/4 and height 5a/32; correcting to s=0 costs at least a/4. Replacing this occurrence by equal coefficients of the first two samples preserves its t coordinate and costs a/4 instead of 13a/32, decreasing cost by 5a/32. Thus the third sample is never needed in a trace minimizer. The first-two-sample segment plus |t| recession gives precisely the displayed whole formula. The page constructions are identical in their coordinates, so their ENTIRE traces agree.

At center z=(1/2,0,0), endpoints z+(1/8)v_i have average z. Each has triangle coordinates (1/2,1/8) with barycentric coefficients (1/4,1/4,1/2). Consequently F_i(endpoint)=L(1/2,1/8)=13/64, whereas F(z)=1/4=16/64. The equal-weight PCC has cost −3/64. Rational hyperplanes and the sample triangles give a common rational refinement; the first-two-sample segment on H is a face of all three assigned triangles, contains the center, and each endpoint is in its assigned triangle. These are genuine legal PCC incidences with saturated lattices, not just an ambient average. Equivalently any common ambient support would require p(v_i)≤−3/8, contradicting p(sum v_i)=0. Thus the glued approximant is not PC and receives no MA. The original f has common supports and receives the regularization of n4; this is not a counterexample to regularizability.

The own exact program enumerates all 35 candidate dual triples for this three-sample epigraph and finds eight feasible vertices: (−1,−1,0),(−1,1,0),(−3/16,1,0),(1/2,−1,0),(1/2,−3/8,0),(1,−1,1/2),(1,5/8,1/2),(1,1,19/32). Their trace affine forms lie below the stated trace by their two endpoint values and outer slopes; the three required trace forms occur, giving a finite entire-trace certificate. The lattice minor gcd is one on all pages. This is an exhaustive finite result for the stated list, distinct from the continuum proofs. notes.summary: Actual saturated raw positivity, exact mass/topology restrictions and a genuine actual-reference crossing-contact witness coexist with the proved regularity.
notes.detailedSummary: Complete positive page cycles and their selected-page residual are balanced/effective. Preserved ambient supports give tangent-corrected divisor positivity on every nonnegative local cycle. Whole BBGS signed/zero calibration precedes S272. Primitive nested-kernel factors yield exactly 2^d d!|det A|; whole S272/S282 common-summand realization gives a finite PA roof with negative contact. Completed measures are used only after n4, with fixed-C moment and weak/BL limits retained.
notes.text:
For actual c_i>0, [X]=sum c_i[L_i] is positive balanced on every rational refinement: each complete page's two facet neighbors have opposite primitive quotient normals and equal weights in the saturated page lattice, cancelling separately even along H. Subtracting c_1[L_1] leaves exactly sum_(i≠1)c_i[L_i], an effective balanced residual. This checks the residual, rather than inferring it from support inclusion.

The raw formula is D_a c(tau)=sum_(sigma>tau)c(sigma)a_sigma(n_sigma/tau)−a_tau(sum c(sigma)n_sigma/tau), with translated saturated tangents and inward primitive quotient normals. At every face choose an ambient local support p; tangent derivatives agree with a_tau. Subtracting p cancels its balanced tangent correction and leaves sum c(sigma)(a_sigma−p)(n_sigma/tau)≥0. Therefore every constructed PA function has genuine divisor positivity on ALL nonnegative local balanced cycles and all refinements, not merely an abstract convex surrogate.

To calibrate recursion, let a_sigma be saturated tangent-lattice covolume and a_vertex=1. A facet basis followed by a primitive complement gives perpendicular primitive length a_sigma/a_tau. Thus Euclidean weights a_sigma c(sigma) satisfy unit-normal balance, and BBGS's negative-unit product obeys B_(−f)(a c)(tau)=a_tau D_f c(tau). Embed x as (x,1) for the original hyperplane convention; metrics on tangents remain unchanged. This holds through every recursive dimension for real, signed and zero weights. Entire BBGS 3.12 supplies subdivision; its 3.15 expands each codimension-two wedge using its two boundary unit rays and bisector reflection, pairs cross terms and proves commutation. Lemma 3.18 characterizes balance by annihilation by every ambient linear form, and 3.19 preserves it by the actual 3.15 equality (its printed commutation reference to 3.12 is corrected). No AR10 delegated recursion is used.

On a finite one-cycle, bounded PA factors b,c have symmetric edge contribution Z(e)(b(v)−b(w))(c(w)−c(v))/L_e, with primitive lattice length L_e. Unbounded affine bounded factors have zero slope. Hence bounded IBP and zero degree of a bounded divisor hold; replacing mixed relative factors by gamma successively gives exact raw mass M=deg gamma, with no appended normalization. After n4 establishes the genuine domain, whole S272 in n1 gives positive finite mixed Radon completion, symmetry, locality, sequence independence and exact mass. For its actual rational component gamma=gamma'+epsilon gamma0, H0=gamma0+c≥0 proper and J0=integral H0 MA(gamma), EVERY completed tuple in max_i||f_i−gamma||≤C satisfies integral H0 MA(tuple)≤(2d/epsilon)CM+J0 and tail mass≤that constant/T. Global uniformity is vague compact-test uniformity. Ordinary weak C_b continuity includes nets; weak C_b/BL uniform continuity is only on each fixed-C family. Entire-domain stronger uniformities remain false. No intermediate n3 function or failed n5 approximant receives MA.

At any rational v in H with at least two pages choose a rational a in L_2 outside L_1; the transverse two-sided line R a meets L_1 only at zero. Extend a saturated dual basis on L_1 to rational ambient forms ell_r vanishing on this line. The ambient convex jet j=sum|ell_r| is rational PA PC and flat in both line directions. For a rational row on a saturated lattice clear denominators, then integer Euclidean operations transform it to (g,0,...,0). Its opposite primitive kernel normals give factor 2g, with rational scaling restored. The kernel is saturated. Nested primitive complements and kernel bases form a basis at each step, so the product of successive positive evaluations is |det A|. Every ordered product of the d distinct absolute forms contributes 2^d|det A|; a repeated form restricts to zero after its own kernel, and a rank-deficient restriction has common lineality and zero top cycle. Exactly d! orders survive for an independent restriction. Therefore m0(j)=2^d d! sum c_i|det A_i|≥c_1 2^d d!>0, with A_1 identity. This is the raw expansion, not an appended factorial.

Whole S272/S282 in n1 supplies actual-reference global realization: the same germ C+t+delta j is built in each rational positive reference summand, and their positive real coefficients sum to one on a common rational refinement. Rational summand maxima have rational walls. Hence F is genuine finite relative REAL PA PC for the SAME actual gamma, flat along the chosen line, with atom delta^d m0(j). For a sufficiently small rational roof R, u=F−gamma+(R−rho(x−v))_+ is bounded genuine real PA. The flat rational boundary PCC bounds every unrestricted competitor at v; radial rational chords bound rational points, and shrinking rational face simplices plus continuity of F bound real centers. Outside the roof the obstacle equals F. Thus the ACTUAL envelope is F. The roof isolates its center atom and contact integral is exactly −R delta^d m0(j)<0. All actual page/subcycle/residual, rational line, carrier and primitive antecedents were checked before invoking the whole grants. This is contact failure coexisting with regularity, not general non-PA contact sufficiency.

The own exact saturated-kernel checker sums ALL 44 factor orders in six fixed matrices, obtaining raw masses 3,8,48,20/3,624,0 for determinants 3/2,1,6,5/6,13,0, respectively. Each nonzero ordered contribution is 2^d|det A|; surviving counts are 1,2,2,2,6,0. These finite examples do not prove the universal determinant formula; the lattice proof above does.
